rules: Original English analysis and an editorially adapted German version for business owners.

This is a personal blog about Soheyl's model and thinking, not a consulting sales page. Do not pitch services, invite bookings, imply a client engagement, add sales calls to action or promise an outcome. Use clear reflective analysis rather than coaching copy. First-person reasoning is allowed; invented first-person experiences are not.
No invented biography, clients, outcomes, quotations, awards, credentials or independent endorsements.
No allegations, named-client stories, disputes, medical/legal/tax advice or novel personal claims in automatic publication.
Hypothetical examples must be labelled hypothetical. Do not invent measured outcomes.
ENDGAME is a developing personal strategy model, not a scientifically validated or uniquely invented system.
New external factual assertions need verified sources and human review; this automatic lane uses approved reasoning only.
Missing evidence, failed review or unresolved deployment means stop, not filler or a backlog dump.
Only article data may be generated. Never execute model output or alter website templates, DNS, secrets or legal pages.
One contribution consists of both EN and DE versions, with the same licensed editorial photograph and localised alt text.
Every new contribution uses /en/blog/<slug>/ and /de/blog/<slug>/. Existing article URLs are preserved.
